approved_question: What synthetic Phase III efficacy evidence is available for Aurelimab in IND-001, and which staged populations showed the largest treatment differences?
approved_response_summary: AURORA-301, AURORA-302, and AURORA-303 provide the approved synthetic Phase III efficacy evidence. The largest descriptive staged Phase III subgroup difference is the AURORA-302 biomarker-positive subgroup at 35 percentage points. All comparisons are fictional and descriptive only.
